comparison.objective: Fit toe-boards along two open platform edges while preventing balls from rolling off; candidate finishes installed HELICOILs.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part placement, edge-gap alignment, and simultaneous loose-object containment versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammering, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Title requires both open edges guarded, no gap wider than 6 mm, and no ball loss; candidate requires four fractures, four recovered tangs, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: The body and specs provide no additional rubric details, but the complete stated objective tests barrier installation and containment, not impact fracture.
